text:
Emily (PM): quick sync — infra told us ETA for the new tenant routing QoS is slipping ~2 weeks. we need a decision on scope cuts vs moving the milestone.
Matt (Eng): ugh. is that the kernel optimization patch backlog or infra capacity?
Raj (SRE): primarily capacity + driver regression. team is pushing hotfix but fallback still 10–14d.
Emily (PM): thanks. options on table: 1) trim multi-tenant pilot (move to v1), 2) ship single-tenant pilot and expand later, 3) delay milestone 2 weeks.
Carla (Sales): customers on the pilot ask for tenant isolation — we risk churn if we punt. but some are ok with single-tenant initial. need a clear comms line.
Sarah (Design): from UX POV single-tenant pilot reduces complexity; we can hide multi-tenant flows behind a feature flag and ship polished surface.
Matt (Eng): technically single-tenant path is the least risky. multi-tenant requires QoS + routing tests across 3 regions.
Theo (Data): for evaluation metrics we can still run v1-scale perf tests in staging to validate cost targets even if not enabled prod.
Jin (Product Ops): remind: milestone acceptance criteria currently include "pilot supports N tenants". we can propose an amendment: accept single-tenant pilot + explicit v1 commitment doc.
Emily (PM): propose concrete compromise: ship MVP as single-tenant pilot (keeps launch date), create v1 milestone with committed timeline for multi-tenant and routing. Carla ok to present to customers?
Carla (Sales): yes, as long as we surface roadmap and a firm timeline for multi-tenant. give me a one-pager to share.
Matt (Eng): agree. impl plan: feature-flag multi-tenant code, default off. push only single-tenant paths to dedicated infra. if QoS hotfix lands earlier we can toggle.
Raj (SRE): add canary gating and autoscale guardrails. recommend a 48h hold before scaling tenant counts.
Emily (PM): draft of the acceptance update: "MVP: single-tenant pilot with feature-flagged multi-tenant code; v1: enable multi-tenant routing, QoS SLOs, and cross-region failover." is that OK?
Sarah (Design): fine. I'll prep the UI disclaimers and an in-product banner for pilot customers.
Matt (Eng): config snippet for the feature flag gate — put this into the release playbook:
```
# feature flag gating
features.multi_tenant.enabled=false
features.multi_tenant.canary_policy="manual-rollout:5\nscale-window:48h"
```
Raj (SRE): add to runbook: if error rate > 0.5% during canary, auto-roll back and notify #eng-oncall.
Jin (Product Ops): I'll update milestone doc and change request. Emily, can you write the customer-facing one-pager?
Emily (PM): on it. deadline EOD tomorrow to give Carla time for outreach.
Carla (Sales): ping me when ready. I'll coordinate with the top 3 pilot customers.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary branch at 2024-06-12T23:40:00Z :rocket:
Theo (Data): one more ask — add telemetry tag "pilot_variant=single-tenant" so we can split analytics later.
Matt (Eng): will add tag.
Emily (PM): decision summary: cut multi-tenant from MVP (feature-flagged, disabled), keep milestone date, create v1 deliverable for multi-tenant. action items: Emily write one-pager; Jin update milestone doc; Matt add flag and telemetry; Raj update runbook; Sarah add UI banner; Carla prep customer comms.
Jin (Product Ops): noted, I'll change the milestone in the tracker and add action owners.
Carla (Sales): thanks all. feels like a good balance between risk + customer expectations. :thumbsup:
Emily (PM): great — if anything changes (hotfix lands earlier) we'll reassess. closing thread for now.
